turns.label: Patient
turns.text: Hey Doc, I'm a 45 year old man coming in, I'm worried there's a little old rash on my leg that I'm getting nervous about.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: Hi, so you I understand you have a rash on your leg.

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: I don't really know what I would call it. That's what I told the nurse when I came in, but it more hurts than anything.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: OK, uh, how long is this been going on for?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: Ah, it's been it's been looking weird for about a week, but only yes, it started hurting yesterday and started looking strange and I just wanted to come in to get it checked out.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: OK when you say it's looking strange, can you tell me what you mean by that?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: Swollen, it looks bigger than it did before, and meaner, if that makes sense.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: Swollen OK, is it red?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: Yeah, it's red, it's turning more red, kind of in the area around it. I've got these I got these scabs. I've got diabetes and I'm not exactly the best with it and scratching at it, and normally it's not that bad, but this is just strange looking and there's no other word for it.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: OK, have you ever had anything like this before? I guess you kinda just said that you didn't, but I'll just double check.

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: No no. Well I've had,  I have occasional ulcers and sometimes I have banged my toe when I'm not exactly the best taking care of my feet, but this is the first time I've gotten something that I don't know, I've just never seen it before.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: Do you have any ulcers right now?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: Let me see. I think so, when's the last time I saw the family doc? I think I've got an ulcer on my left heel, but I think it's doing alright.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: OK, and what leg are you having this problem with?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: Right now it's on my right, so my ankle.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: OK, how have your sugars been controlled recently?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: I stopped measuring them. Yeah, last time I measured it was pretty bad. I think my A1C last time was like 9 something. I'm trying, I'm trying better to be with it. It's hard with work you know?

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: For sure, I can imagine so, in general, even if you don't know your numbers for your sugars, have you felt worse than usual lately? Have you felt rundown at all?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: Yeah, actually I have gained more, feel hungry, sometimes just tired, but it's hard to tell. There's an awful lot going on in my life right now with the kids, but, It's hard to tell I think. Yeah, I need to see my family doc.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: OK. Definitely you know a good a good idea moving forward just to make sure you get on top of these things, but I'm glad you came in today so we can, you know, have a better look at you and make sure that there's nothing super concerning going on. So in addition to this, have you had any other new symptoms?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: Symptoms? Um, I feel a little hot actually. When the swelling started it's it also started leaking this like white stuff from one of the one of what used to be a scab so now like kind of an open wound now.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: OK, OK so when did you start feeling hot?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: Honestly, last 12 hours.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: OK, you take your temperature at all?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: No, I don't have a thermometer at home.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: Have you had any difficulty breathing?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: No no.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: Any chest pain?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: No.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: Have you noticed that your left, sorry, your right leg feels any hotter than the left?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: Yeah, yeah it does. Actually changing socks the other day, yeah.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: Right. Say, have you alone have you felt ill recently? Have you been sick at all?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: Aside from just feeling overall crummy last couple weeks, no don't really, less energy today, but I was up last night thinking about this and yeah wanted to come in and talk.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: OK yeah, you did the right thing. I'm glad that you're in today. Is the pain on your legs worse when you touch it?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: Yeah, maybe not so much when I touch it. When I walk with it and I start flexing it it, it doesn't like that.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: OK, uhm.

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: Just resting it right now, it feels fine.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: It's OK, OK. OK, well I'm going to if I think of any more questions specifically about your leg I will, I'll go back to it, but I'm going to just move on and ask you questions about your overall health. You've already shared with me that you you are diabetic. Do you have any other chronic conditions that you live with?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: Chronic condition? I see the family doc about cholesterol. I'm on a pill for that. Uhm, I had asthma as a kid, not too much of an issue now. And my back, I've had back pain for the last 10 years, but all I really take for it is Tylenol Advil for that.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: OK, oh my other question about your leg was, have you lost any feeling in it?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: It kind of is like a dull ache sometimes when I touch it. But, no like,  in the area, the ankle no, but definitely on my feet, like over the years I've noticed I feel less on it compared to what I did previously, yeah.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: OK, so sorry I kind of sidetracked there so we talked about your diabetes. You said you have high cholesterol. So what medications are you currently taking?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: I'm taking 4 pills right now. One of them is for the cholesterol. I think it's called. rosuvastatin. The other three, they're all diabetes medications, but I don't remember. Metformin is one of them. Sidas...something I have a list somewhere. I'll give it to you later.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: OK, are you on insulin right now?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: No.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: Are you on any or any of these medications new to you, recently?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: No no, but had them for about a year now.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: Do you have any allergies?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: Um, yeah, I do actually. Penicillin, can't take that.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: And what happens when you take penicillin?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: It's been a while, as a kid apparently like my face got bloated and I was having a hard time breathing so...

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: Well, we will make sure that we don't give you that. Can you tell me if you've had any previous surgery?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: Oh yeah, uh, what was it? I had my sinuses, had some pretty bad sinusitis when I was in my teens and they went in and kind of carved a little space out.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: OK, OK. Is that the only surgery that you had?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: Yeah.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: And can you tell me, do you have any family history of diabetes, skin problems, anything else that stands out to you?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: Yep, mom's side of the family, very much everyone has diabetes, high blood pressure, cholesterol. Dad's side of the the family is pretty healthy. I think maybe one of my aunts had lung cancer, but she's a pretty big smoker too.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: And then just ask you a few questions about your lifestyle. So you said that you have children.

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: Yeah, I do.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: Do you live in town? Do you live with your kids?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: I live in town. I see my kids every two weeks.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: And, uh. What do you do for work? Did I already ask you this?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: No, I'm currently unemployed and looking for work, partially employed, I suppose we should say I have my own business.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: I see and, what do you, what do you do when when you are working, ideally?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: When I am working, I'm an accountant.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: OK well, and do you smoke?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: Yeah once in a while, yeah, when I'm stressed.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: How much do you smoke on average?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: Last couple of weeks, I've been smoking more, maybe like 2 packs a week.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: OK. Do you drink alcohol?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: Yeah yeah.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: How much do you typically drink?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: Average week, maybe a 2 4.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: So maybe like 3 per day or something like that if you were to average it out?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: Yeah, if you average out I mainly go through the two four in a weekend to be honest.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: Oh, I see. OK, more so on the weekend, so maybe a little bit more than three per day on those days?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: Mhm.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: OK so that that that's everything that I need to ask you for now. I'd like to get a closer look at this leg. Did you have any other questions or concerns before we move forward to the physical exam?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: No I just want to get this figured out.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: OK, yeah, we will definitely do that for you. So yeah, I'm going to have a look at it and then after that I will go talk to the doctor that I'm working with and we'll see what we can do for you. That sounds good?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: Thank you doc, yeah sounds great.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: Awesome OK thanks.
